reviews.author: zy zii
reviews.text:
This was my second visit to Sensen Salon, and once again, I had a wonderful experience! Leha did an amazing job cutting and curling my hair. She listened carefully to what I wanted and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire process. The haircut suited me perfectly, and the curls were absolutely beautiful. I left the salon feeling more confident, refreshed, and beautiful than ever.
The owner was also very welcoming and friendly, creating a warm and relaxing atmosphere from the moment I walked in. Their kindness and hospitality made the entire experience even more special.
I'm truly impressed by the consistent quality of service and attention to detail. Thank you, Leha, for your talent, professionalism, and excellent care. I highly recommend Leha and Teri to anyone looking for a stylist who genuinely cares about making her clients look and feel their best. I can't wait for my next visit!
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you so much for your wonderful review.  We truly appreciate it.

reviews.author: Maryjane Corpin
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a wonderful experience at Senses Salon during my hair spa treatment. The service was relaxing, professional, and exceeded my expectations. My hair felt incredibly soft, nourished, and refreshed after the treatment.
A special thank you to Ate Terry and her colleague Liya for their exceptional care and attention. They were both friendly, attentive, and highly skilled, ensuring I was comfortable throughout the entire experience. Their professionalism and warm attitude made my visit truly enjoyable.
I highly recommend Senses Salon to anyone looking for excellent hair care services. Thank you, Ate Terry and Liya, for the fantastic service I will definitely be coming back! 💕✨🌸

reviews.author: Di Ja
reviews.text: Amazing phloreten hair spa by Leha at Senses Salon and my hair feels fresh, clean and less dry. Relaxing atmosphere, professional and friendly staff and worth the time.

reviews.text:
Excellent Service & Amazing Experience!

reviews.author: Lucy
reviews.text:
I went to The Sense Salon and honestly I’m so happy with the result. They spent a lot of time on my hair and didn’t rush anything, and it came out absolutely perfect.

Terry did my hair and wow… she’s insanely good at what she does. Super skilled and really pays attention to detail. Oland (I hope I’m spelling it right) also worked on my hair throughout the process and was really great and attentive the whole time.

Overall such a great experience, really professional but also very welcoming. I’d 100% come back again.

reviews.author: Vinora Saldanha
reviews.text: Had a great experience! The hair spa was incredibly relaxing, and my hair felt so soft, smooth, and refreshed afterward. The body waxing was done professionally with great attention to hygiene, and the stylists Leha and Terri made the entire process as comfortable and painless as possible. They were friendly, patient, and attentive throughout. I'm really happy with the service and would definitely recommend them. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Geetanjali Digga
reviews.text:
visited Senses Salon for the first time recently, and I was genuinely impressed. From the warm welcome at reception to the professional service, the entire experience exceeded my expectations.

The salon is beautifully maintained, with a relaxing atmosphere that makes you feel comfortable straight away. The staff were friendly, attentive, and took the time to understand exactly what I wanted.

It’s not often that a first visit leaves such a positive impression, but Senses Salon definitely did. I left feeling pampered, refreshed, and extremely happy with the results. I’ll definitely be returning and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality service and a great salon experience.

reviews.author: Walaa Wagih
reviews.text:
Honestly, they deserve more than 5 stars! 🤍
I’ve been going to this salon for years and every single visit is amazing. Everything is always perfect — the facial, mani & pedi, blow dry… literally every service is done with so much care and professionalism.

The place itself is beautiful, clean, and has such a relaxing vibe. Every time I leave, I feel fresh, relaxed, and genuinely happy. The staff are super friendly and always make me feel comfortable and welcomed.

I truly love this salon and highly recommend it to anyone who wants to pamper themselves and have a great experience. Definitely one of my favorite places ever ✨

reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at Senses! Leha was very professional. Facial was very relaxing and thorough. They even did buffer shine in mani pedi. Will definitely come again. FYI location is inside OAKS height.

reviews.author: Angie Kristie
reviews.text:
Booked appointment one week in advance for a hair spa that I was offered complimentary by the salon, under name Sophia.

Arrived on time and waiting for 15 mins until the hair dresser came to me and said she feels sorry for me waiting so the other hairdresser will come from home although she was sick.
I left and I wasted one hour of my life for a supposed free hair spa.
A kind advice to be respectful on everyone’s time and inform in advance if there is no hair dresser for booked appointment.
🤦🏻‍♀️

Good luck with your business.

reviews.author: Lavanya Mukesh
reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to this salon regularly for my treatments, and they never disappoint. Every time, I leave with the best results, which is why I keep coming back!

The team here is incredibly sweet, welcoming, and friendly they really make you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in. I especially love the work Terry does; you can truly see how passionate she is about what she does, and it reflects in her results.

And Crystal honestly, she makes you feel like a friend instantly! She’s always smiling, warm, and so kind. Overall, such a wonderful person and such a great experience every time.

Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality service and a friendly atmosphere!

From
Lavanya

reviews.author: Tazmin Mohamed
reviews.text:
I recently had the most amazing experience at Senses Salon, and I just had to share it with the world! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and friendliness by the incredible staff. Zaida, the owner, and her team were so accommodating and made me feel right at home.

Let me start by talking about the Phloroten treatment they did on my hair. Oh my goodness, it was a game-changer! Not only did it make my hair incredibly smooth, but it also gave it an instant boost of health, shine, manageability, and thickness. The best part? My hair still retained its natural curl and pattern, which is something I've struggled to find in other treatments. Plus, they even offer a jet straight option for those who prefer it. Talk about catering to all preferences!

But that's not all, folks. Senses Salon also took care of my nails and toes, and let me tell you, the results were beyond incredible. The foot spa pedicure left my feet feeling as soft as a baby's bottom. I couldn't help but smile every time I looked at my beautifully manicured nails and perfectly pampered toes. They truly know how to make you feel like royalty.

I can't stress enough how much I recommend Senses Salon to anyone looking for a top-notch salon experience. Zaida and her team go above and beyond to ensure their clients are happy and satisfied. The atmosphere is so inviting, and you'll definitely leave feeling like a million bucks.

So, if you're in need of a salon that will not only make you look fabulous but also provide exceptional service, look no further than Senses Salon. Trust me, you won't be disappointed.
